questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. mathematics.

questions.question: Which one of the following words is correctly spelt ?
questions.questionHtml: Which one of the following words is correctly spelt?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. maintenance.

Key Points

  • The word "maintenance" means the process of preserving something, especially through regular upkeep and repair. (रखरखाव)
    • Example: The maintenance of the garden requires regular watering and weeding.
  • "Necessarry" is incorrectly spelled; the correct spelling is "necessary", which means required to be done, achieved, or present; needed. (आवश्यक)
    • Example: It is necessary to drink water every day to stay hydrated.
  • "Remidial" is incorrectly spelled; the correct spelling is "remedial", which means intended to correct or improve something, especially a student's learning. (सुधारात्मक)
    • Example: The school offers remedial classes for students who need extra help.
  • "Commitee" is incorrectly spelled; the correct spelling is "committee", which means a group of people appointed for a specific function. (समिति)
    • Example: The committee will meet next week to discuss the new project.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. maintenance.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Necessarry (आवश्यक): Incorrectly spelled; the correct spelling is "necessary".
    • Example: It is necessary to follow the rules to maintain order.
  • Remidial (सुधारात्मक): Incorrectly spelled; the correct spelling is "remedial".
    • Example: The teacher provided remedial lessons for students struggling with math.
  • Commitee (समिति): Incorrectly spelled; the correct spelling is "committee".
    • Example: The committee is responsible for organizing the annual event.

questions.question: Direction: Choose the misspelt word.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "Accelarating".

Key Points 

  • Let's explore the options:
    • ​'Contemporary' means belonging to the same time as somebody/something else. 
      • ​Example: A magazine devoted to contemporary fashions.
    • 'Instantaneous' means happening immediately or extremely quickly.
      • ​Example: His hospitality was instantaneous and all-embracing.
    • 'Commissioned' means to ask an artist, writer, etc. to do a piece of work.
      • ​Example: The Ministry of Agriculture commissioned a study into low-input farming.
    • 'Accelarating': There is no such word in English or we can say that there is some spelling mistake in this word.
      • The correct spelling is 'Accelerating' which means to go faster; to make something go faster or happen more quickly. 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Additional Information 

  • The synonyms of the word 'Accelerating' are growing, progressing, and advancing.
  • Example of 'Accelerating' in a sentence.
    • ​Example: Accelerating technological development has pushed the government of every country off-balance in the past decade.

questions.question: Direction: Choose the misspelt word.

questions.question: Select the CORRECTLY spelt word.
questions.solution:

Key Points

  • Let's us look at the options:
    • "Administratur": This word is incorrectly spelled.
      • The correct spelling is "Administrator", describing a person responsible for running a business, organization, etc.
    • "Administrater": This spelling is also incorrect.
      • The correct form of the word is "Administrator".
    • "Administrator": This spelling is correct.
      • An administrator is a person who manages and organizes the affairs of a business, institution or other organization.
    • "Aministretor": This is not a correctly spelled word.

  • So, among these 4 options, the correctly spelled word is "Administrator". 

Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question: Identify the MISSPELT word in the following sentence. In our school, innovative and effective academic and evaluation strategies and intervantions are needed.
questions.questionHtml:
Identify the MISSPELT word in the following sentence.

In our school, innovative and effective academic and evaluation strategies and intervantions are needed.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'intervantions'.

Key Points

  • The misspelled word in the sentence is "intervantions." The correct spelling should be "interventions."
  • In Hindi: "हस्तक्षेप" (Hastakshap)
  • "Interventions" refers to actions or steps taken to improve a situation, solve a problem, or alter a course of events for the better. In an educational setting, interventions might include additional support, specialized teaching methods, or strategies implemented to help students succeed academically or behaviorally.
    • Example: The teacher implemented various interventions to support struggling students in the classroom.
       

Correct Answer: Intervantions.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word from the given sentence. This book has proved inspirative and instruktive to me while reading.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word from the given sentence.

This book has proved inspirative and instruktive to me while reading.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 3.

Key Points

  • The word "instruktive" is incorrect. It does not have any meaning in English. (अर्थहीन)
    • Example: None, as the word is incorrectly spelt and doesn't exist.
  • The correct word is "instructive", which means serving to inform or provide knowledge. (शिक्षाप्रद)
    • Example: The lecture was very instructive and helped me understand the topic better.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Inspirative (प्रेरणादायक): Something that provides inspiration or encouragement.
    • Example: The inspirative speech motivated everyone to work harder.
  • Reading (पढ़ना): The action or skill of reading written or printed matter silently or aloud.
    • Example: She spends most of her evenings reading books.
  • Proved (साबित हुआ): To demonstrate the truth or existence of something by evidence or argument.
    • Example: His theory was proved correct by the recent experiments.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word from the given sentence. The city had a hundred thousand inhabitents-some think double as many.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word from the given sentence.

The city had a hundred thousand inhabitents-some think double as many.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 2.

Key Points

  • The word "inhabitants" refers to the people who live in a particular place. (निवासी)
    • Example: The inhabitants of the remote island have their own unique culture and traditions.
  • The incorrectly spelt word in the given sentence is "inhabitents", which is a misspelling of "inhabitants". (निवासी)
    • Example: The correct spelling is 'inhabitants', referring to all the people living in a particular area or place.
  • Hence, the misspelled word that needs correction is 'inhabitents'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Hundred (सौ): A numerical value representing one hundred units.
    • Example: She saved a hundred dollars for her trip.
  • Double (दोगुना): To increase or be increased by twice the amount.
    • Example: The recipe requires double the amount of sugar mentioned in the original.
  • Thousand (हज़ार): A numerical value representing one thousand units.
    • Example: The charity event raised several thousand dollars for the cause.
